🚨 MARK THE CALENDAR 🚨

Noche Latina is BACK and this time Cynthia Marche is commanding the Ranchero Room. 👑🔥

Un hidalgo. Un perreo. Y un buen beso. That's the promise, that's the night. Expect a show that'll make you blush — then straight into hot Latino beats till your feet give out. 💃🕺

This is the one you tell your crew about weeks later. Get here early, get your tequila lined up, and get ready to lose it on that dance floor.

🗓️ Saturday, July 25, 2026
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15 cover
🔞 21+

Neon lights. Sun setting pink and gold behind the Ranchero Room. And that bass already thumping in your chest before you even walk in. 🌅🔊

That's Noche Latina.

Cynthia Marche owns that stage like it was built for her — the kind of performance that gets you blushing one second and screaming the next. Then the DJ takes over and it's all hot Latino beats, tequila shots clinking, and bodies moving till the night just... disappears. 🍋🥃💋

Un hidalgo. Un perreo. Y un buen beso. Feel it before you even step through the door.

Come exactly as you are, Pasco. 💃🕺✨

Noche Latina isn't about fitting a mold — it's about showing up, being seen, and dancing like nobody's watching (even though everybody is). Cynthia Marche brings the glam, the heat, the whole vibe — and the dance floor does the rest.

Your people are already here. The tacones, the cowboy hats, the red dresses, the tank tops — todos bienvenidos. This is Latinx Pasco's night to shine, together, loud, and unapologetic.

Bring your crew. Bring your best moves. Leave the shy version of you at home. 🔥
